decision: Add a bounded read-only directory listing and a lazy right-side tree panel: FileEntry/FileListResponse in shared/protocol, listDirectory in src/serve/files (hidden/ignored split, dirs-first sort, limit+truncated), GET /api/files, api.listFiles, and a FileTree panel with expand/cache, hidden/ignored toggles, refresh, loading and retry
why: a later milestone writes files and the UI needs a listing to hang them on, and the response shape is a fixed contract later units must not re-derive
evidence: test/serve/files.test.ts (dirs-first + held-back dotfiles/ignored, real size and numeric mtime, showHidden/showIgnored, symlink kind, limit+truncated, escape/NotADirectory), test/serve/files-http.test.ts (root, ?path=src, 400 escape with no listing leak, 404, ?showHidden=1)
result: 1088 tests (3 pre-existing env-flaky lsp/claude spawn-timeout tests fail under full parallel load, pass in isolation), typecheck, lint, vite build green; commit e42e3a5

decision: Stream one workspace file to the browser: statPath in src/serve/files classifies missing/directory/file, GET /api/files/download streams via createReadStream with attachment/octet-stream/length headers, api.fileDownloadUrl builds the token-aware link, and each non-directory FileTree row gets a 下载 anchor
why: the owner must pull artifacts the agent wrote out of the workspace, and streaming a real HTTP response (never a buffered body) keeps a large file off the server and browser heaps
evidence: test/serve/files-http.test.ts (byte-for-byte 200 with Content-Disposition basename and Content-Length, 400 escape as JSON not bytes, 404 missing, 400 directory message), test/web/api.test.ts (fileDownloadUrl percent-encodes the path and appends the token)
result: 1090/1092 tests (2 pre-existing env-flaky lsp/claude spawn-timeout tests fail under full parallel load, pass in isolation), typecheck, lint, vite build green; commit 3f1527f

decision: Multipart streaming upload: register @fastify/multipart (fileSize 100 MiB, files 20, fields 10, preservePath so a traversal is seen), POST /api/files/upload with a route bodyLimit above the cap and the global 1 MiB limit, per-file basename validation, a temp-sibling stream + rename with a byte counter, the exists/overwrite policy, api.upload over XMLHttpRequest with progress, and a FileTree drop target with a per-file progress list and an overwrite retry
why: the owner must land artifacts into a chosen workspace directory with progress and an overwrite policy, and streaming each part to disk keeps a large file off the server and browser heaps
evidence: test/serve/files-http.test.ts (small file byte-for-byte with the written relative path, a >1 MiB body, exists then overwrite asserting the new bytes, ../evil.txt refused on the name with no escape, path=../../etc 400, over-cap 413, mixed ok:false with written+failed), test/web/api.test.ts (FormData path/overwrite/token and progress, ok:false resolves, 413 rejects with the server reason)
result: 1101 tests (2 pre-existing env-flaky lsp/claude tests fail under full parallel load, pass in isolation), typecheck, lint, vite build green; commit 5d88c2d

decision: A filesystem-style workspace picker: GET /api/fs/dirs bounded to the home directory plus the active workspace root (a files binding from runServe, pure isInsideBrowseRoots and browseDirectories helpers, directories only sorted by name, parent null at a root with no allowed ancestor), api.listDirs, a WorkspaceBrowser modal with a clickable breadcrumb, 上一级, 选择当前目录, the recent list and a manual absolute-path fallback, and keyboard arrows/Enter/Escape, with WorkspacePicker opening it instead of a bare dropdown
why: the owner needs to pick a workspace off the disk instead of typing a path, and the browse read must stay inside home and the live root so the picker never widens what the server can read
evidence: test/serve/fs-dirs-http.test.ts (home default lists only alpha+beta sorted with parent null, ?path=<home>/alpha lists deep with parent home, workspace root lists src with parent null while a path under it reports the workspace as parent, /etc is 400 with no dirs key, a missing in-root path is 404, isInsideBrowseRoots accepts each root and anything under it and rejects /etc, a home sibling, and .. climbs), test/web/api.test.ts (listDirs("/home/x") issues GET /api/fs/dirs?path=%2Fhome%2Fx)
result: 1108 tests (3 pre-existing env-flaky lsp/claude tests fail under full parallel load, pass in isolation), typecheck, lint, vite build green; commit 69b47c5

decision: Filesystem-style structure operations: isValidEntryName plus mkdirInWorkspace/renameEntry/moveEntry/deleteEntry in src/serve/files (resolveInWorkspace and a name guard, existing-target refusal, root and missing-source guards, a directory-into-its-own-subtree check, an EXDEV copy-then-delete with rollback, and a recursive-only directory delete), a FileOpError carrying the route status, POST /api/files/mkdir|rename|move|delete answering { ok: true } or { ok: false, error } with 400/404/500, api.mkdir/renameEntry/moveEntry/deleteEntry, and a per-row FileTree menu (新建文件夹, an inline 重命名, a 移动到… picker over the browse route, and an armed 删除 naming the directory's entry count)
why: the owner must restructure the workspace from the tree, and every write stays bounded to the workspace while an irreversible delete is confirmed first
evidence: test/serve/files.test.ts (isValidEntryName rejects empty/./../separator/NUL; mkdir creates parents and refuses an existing target; rename preserves bytes and refuses an existing destination and the root; move refuses its own subtree untouched and an existing destination; delete removes a file, refuses a non-empty directory without recursive, removes it recursive, refuses the root and a missing path), test/serve/files-ops-http.test.ts (real HTTP: mkdir creates on disk then 400 with a reason and ../x 400; rename changes the disk bytes, an existing target 400, the root 400; move relocates, self-subtree 400 untouched, existing 400; delete file, non-recursive 400 leaves it, recursive removes it, root 400, missing 404), test/web/api.test.ts (the four literal routes and bodies plus the server reason surfaced)
result: 1137/1138 tests (1 pre-existing env-flaky lsp timeout under full parallel load, passes in isolation), typecheck, lint, vite build green; commit fd2e320

decision: Folder zip download: src/serve/zip.ts streaming writer on node:zlib only (local header with the data-descriptor and UTF-8 flags, deflated bytes via createDeflateRaw with a counting transform so crc32 and the uncompressed size come from the source, a 16-byte data descriptor, central directory with the 0x10 directory bit and end record, a depth-first walk emitting a trailing-slash zero-length entry per subdirectory, symlink policy: an outside-root link is skipped while an inside link is archived as its target's bytes, a 4 GiB value refused naming zip64), GET /api/files/archive answering application/zip with an attachment basename and 400/404/400 for escape/missing/file, api.fileArchiveUrl, and a FileTree directory-row 打包下载 anchor
why: the owner must pull a whole workspace directory out as one download, and streaming the archive (never buffering it) keeps a large tree off the server heap while node:zlib alone avoids a new dependency
evidence: test/serve/files-archive-http.test.ts (a directory archive read back with an in-process node:zlib reader: 200, application/zip, attachment src.zip, posix relative names, a trailing-slash nested/ entry, byte-for-byte binary and text inflations, an inside symlink archived as its target while an outside symlink is absent, and the root listing with no absolute name; ../x 400, a missing directory 404, a file 400 with a clear message), test/web/api.test.ts (fileArchiveUrl percent-encodes the path and appends the token), a real unzip -t of a produced archive reports no errors
result: 1143 tests (3 pre-existing env-flaky lsp/claude spawn-timeout tests fail under full parallel load, pass in isolation), typecheck, lint, vite build green; commit bde8eec

decision: Keep the tree live on agent writes and add click-to-read: a files_changed ServerEvent carrying workspace-relative posix paths, a FilesChangedTracker in src/serve/files-changed that remembers each tool_started args by call id and names the write_file/edit_file path (or the empty list for bash, a missing path, or an escape) on an ok tool_finished, SoloHub and TeamHub each emit it, the reducer keeps a monotonic filesVersion plus the changed paths, FileTree re-reads its visible directories and pulses the named rows, and a file click sends the workspace chat a message asking it to read that path
why: the owner must see a file the agent wrote without pressing refresh, and the event must stay one fixed contract between both hubs and the tree
evidence: test/serve/files-changed.test.ts (write_file and edit_file name the literal normalized rel path, a read/glob emits nothing, bash emits [], the ../escape, /etc, and absent paths fall back to [], and error/blocked writes are dropped), test/serve/solo.test.ts and test/serve/team.test.ts (a real write_file turn through each hub emits files_changed with the literal path), test/web/state.test.ts (filesVersion advances by one per event including an empty list while other events leave it)
result: 1152 tests (3 pre-existing env-flaky lsp/claude spawn-timeout tests fail under full parallel load, pass in isolation), typecheck, lint, vite build green; commit 9327dc4
